summary: Backend-only incremental test for LatinHub 'schools' module. Added /app/backend/tests/test_schools.py with 17 tests covering GET /api/schools (+ city & style filters, desc-by-students sort), GET /api/schools/{id} (200 & 404), POST /api/schools (401 unauth, 200 authed w/ owner_id+slug, 422 bio<10 & name<2 Pydantic validation), GET /api/my/school (401 unauth, null for new user, returns owned school). Also ran full regression: events count, Mauro-first DJ with exact spotify embed URL, admin login. 39/39 tests pass (17 new + 22 existing).
action_items: No code changes required for the schools feature; all acceptance criteria from the review request are verified green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _slugify() correctly handles collisions by appending a 6-char uuid suffix when the generated slug already exists — verified indirectly by the POST test.
School.owner_id is Optional but correctly set to current_user['id'] on POST; GET /api/my/school queries by this field (indexed at startup) — good.
Pydantic v2 Field(min_length=...) enforces bio/name length at the request-validation layer (422), so no manual validation code needed.
Schools seed is idempotent (counts == 0 check) — matches the other collections. Seeded count is exactly 5 Italian schools as required (Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bologna, Torino).
server.py grown to ~818 lines (was ~636). Still a single-file MVP but the split into modules (auth/events/djs/mixes/schools) is becoming more justified.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed creation. Server auto-seeds 5 schools on startup. Tests that need a fresh owner use POST /api/auth/register with unique TEST_ UUID emails so reruns remain idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds: admin@latinhub.it / admin123. Bearer JWT (7-day), no cookies. Schools endpoints: GET /api/schools (query city, style; 'all' sentinel bypasses style filter), GET /api/schools/{id} (404 on miss), POST /api/schools (auth, Pydantic Field min_length on name>=2 and bio>=10 → 422 on violation), GET /api/my/school (auth, returns null if user has no school). Seeded schools sort by students desc: Milano 420, Roma 310, Torino 240, Napoli 185, Bologna 155. Slug auto-generated as '<name>-<city>' lowercased with non-alphanumeric -> '-'. MOCKED: none for schools (all URLs are example/real marketing links).
